book.title: 小蚂蚁运球
book.subtitle: 安安的大班亲子运动会

moral.zh: 两个人做着不同的事，也能商量出一个一起往前走的节奏。
moral.en: Partners can have different jobs and still find a way to move together.

pages.zhText: 今天是大班亲子运动会。彩旗在操场上轻轻晃，妈妈抱着一颗篮球。安安牵住妈妈的手，拉着她往红跑道那边跑。
pages.enText: It was sports day at An’an’s kindergarten, and families were joining in. Little flags fluttered over the playground. Mom had a basketball under one arm. An’an took her hand and ran toward the red track.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Opening and cover. An’an leads Mom by the hand toward the red running track. Mom carries the orange basketball under her free arm. A blue hula hoop rests on the track in the background. Pennants and cream school building, warm morning wide view. The grass in front of the school and outer track edge, especially the broad open area on the right and the gaps left of and between the leads, have several families arriving and waiting. Show about 10–14 other adults and kindergarten children in small groups. Some approach hand-in-hand, some face the track and clap. Use a second row farther back where there is room.

pages.zhText: 张老师指指地上的圈。“小朋友在前面拉圈，家长跟在后面拍球。球每一下都要落在圈里。这个游戏叫‘小蚂蚁运球’。”
pages.enText: Teacher Zhang pointed at the hoop on the ground. “Kids pull the hoop from the front. Grown-ups follow behind and bounce the ball. Every bounce has to land inside the hoop. We call it the Little Ants’ Ball Race.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Teacher Zhang points at the opening of the blue hoop on the red track. An’an watches the pointing hand and Mom holds the ball. The teacher has a high ponytail, yellow top and a whistle on a navy lanyard. A small group of waiting kindergarten children, each with a parent, watches and listens from the far grass edge. A few more families are visible by the school beyond them.

pages.enText: Lele and his dad showed everyone how to play. Lele pulled the hoop forward. Thump! The ball bounced inside it. Teacher Zhang explained that if the ball bounced out, the pair had to go back to the start and try again. The first pair to reach the finish won.

Keep the active hoop area and lane clear.

parentGuide.goal: 让孩子说出安安和妈妈各自的任务，并发现两个人怎样用球落地的声音配合。
parentGuide.reminder: 读到球出圈时，停下来等孩子说说安安可能在想什么。再看她和妈妈回到起点后各自做了什么。
questions: 球落到圈外以后，安安和妈妈回到了哪里？
第二次出发时，安安听见了什么，就知道可以迈一小步？
parentGuide.activity: 一人轻敲桌面一下，另一人用手指往前走一步。一个人变快或变慢，两人一起找回舒服的节奏，再交换角色。

ageTips.age4to5: 请孩子指一指谁拉圈、谁拍球，再用一个敲击声配一个小动作。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子讲讲第二趟两个人各自做了什么，再想出一个自己愿意试的配合信号。
